defect: `install::standard` only creates the `-t` directory under `-D` in the single-file `else` branch, failing to create the target directory when multiple source files are installed via `copy_files_into_dir`.
factor's optimized modular multiplication/arithmetic routines in `numeric.rs` overflow for inputs above 2^63 when invoked by the Pollard's rho / Miller-Rabin factorization pipeline.

mv::exec added an early `if sources.contains(target_dir)` return before calling `move_files_into_dir`, aborting `mv dir1 dir2 dir2` instead of moving `dir1` into `dir2` and reporting an error only for `dir2`.

`ls` `Config::from` sets `show_control = true` when stdout is a terminal (`atty::is(Stdout)`) instead of `!atty::is(Stdout)`, inverting the default control-character escaping behavior on terminals vs pipes.

`MountInfo::new` in `df` parses `/proc/self/mountinfo` using `raw[8]` for `dev_name` and `raw[7]` for `fs_type` instead of `raw[9]` and `raw[8]`, misreporting filesystem type and device name on Linux.

`OdOptions::new` checks `line_bytes % min_bytes != 0` without checking `line_bytes == 0`, allowing `-w0` (since `0 % min_bytes == 0`) to pass into the output loop instead of falling back to `min_bytes`.

`Row::from` in `df/src/table.rs` computes `inodes_usage` as `ffree / files` (free ratio) instead of `(files - ffree) / files` (used ratio), causing `DisplayRow` to print `IFree%` in the `IUse%` column.
`pr`'s `--page` implementation in `print_page` returns `Ok(0)` for pages outside `[start_page, end_page]` instead of signalling abort past `end_page` and skips range validation in `build_options`.

`od::uu_app` defines `-t/--format` with `.multiple(true)` without `.number_of_values(1)`, causing clap to absorb subsequent filename arguments as format specs so `od --format x1 file` reads stdin instead of `file`.
`TranslateOperation::new` sets `s2_last` to `s2_prev` (last element consumed while iterating `set1`) instead of `set2.last()`, breaking `tr -c` when `set2` is longer than `set1` (e.g., a range).
